assertion_audit.fails_if: the named run's pointer exists in the real crew home; guards fixture isolation, not the landing.
the reviewed head is already on the remote main before the call; a negative precondition read from git.
the second caller keeps the refusal and exits 1; the base arm shows this.
the head is not merged; git ancestry on the origin is independent of the head the test supplied.
the pointer survives a successful call.
a pending record is left behind after the landing clears it.
the promotion retires a pointer a newer attempt wrote; the fixture writes attempt 4 from inside the promotion's own commit step, so dropping the identity check makes read_pointer raise.
the promotion rewrites the newer attempt's pointer.
the record cites a head re-derived from the worktree; the test advances the tree to a second commit first, so a re-derivation writes that commit and only the reviewed-head argument writes run head.
an existing pending record is replaced; the test writes the advanced head itself and the code must leave it.

assertion_independence: No assertion is a self-equality pair: ancestry reads git, attempt 4 is written by the fixture, and the cited-head case advances the worktree first so a re-derived value would differ from the one supplied.

findings.text: _ATTEMPT_IDENTITY_FIELDS is a second attempt-identity vocabulary beside pending_landing._ATTEMPT_FIELDS at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:168, and _retire_a_raced_pointer at promotion.py:318 re-implements the compare-under-lock-and-retire capability already owned by _remove_promoted_pointer at promotion.py:223, _retire_review_pointer at promotion.py:277 and _release_marked_pointer at pending_landing.py:194; the addition duplicates rather than extends the owner, leaving four divergent retirement guards.

the append-race call site passes finishing_another_writers_row=already_promoted, but no case in tests/test_a_raced_promotion_still_lands.py drives ledger.append_run raising after the row appears, so reverting this argument alone leaves all three cases green and restores the original refusal for that window.

when the live pointer disappears between the two reads, _retire_a_raced_pointer returns _RACED_POINTER_ABSENT, the branch falls through to _keep_pointer_for_pending_landing, which reports failure on an absent pointer, and the bare raise at promotion.py:404 re-raises a message claiming the pointer was kept and marked although nothing was marked.

the base importer arm's log carries two complete runs under one four-line header, the first ending in its own EXIT=1 at line 4265 with the head arm's figures and the second ending at line 5849 with 65 failed, 776 passed, 25 errors; the base reading is not reproducible from the file without splitting it.
